subject: Vendor recertification and PO synchronization — Redwood renewal & expansion
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: procurement@orionhealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor recertification and PO synchronization — Redwood renewal & expansion

Hi Sarah / procurement team,

Hope you’re well — quick note as Orion’s renewal window approaches for our Redwood Hosted plan and the proposed capacity uplift. We’re planning a small term amendment + seat uplift for the production org and want to align vendor recertification so your team can accept the PO without delay.

What we need from our side to complete your vendor onboarding:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (link below)
- Signed SOW for the capacity increase (I’ve attached a draft)
- W9 and bank details for PO processing (I can attach once you confirm portal requirements)

Suggested mutual action plan (MAP) to keep dates tight:
1) 8/21 — I send onboarding form + SOW draft (today)
2) 8/25 — your procurement confirms vendor_id + portal steps
3) 8/29 — you issue PO for the baseline renewal (we accept split PO if helpful)
4) 9/02 — capacity addendum effective upon PO receipt

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, SOW_Renewal_Orion_2025.docx
Links: SOC2 (public) — https://redwood.app/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_2024.pdf

If it helps, happy to run a 20-minute intake with your procurement ops this week to walk the portal fields and speed up submission. What’s the best time?

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SOW_Renewal_Orion_2025.docx (docx)]

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@orionhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor recertification and PO synchronization — Redwood renewal & expansion

Hi Naomi — thanks for the summary.

Quick Qs from procurement:
- Can you provide the SOC2 PDF rather than a link? Our portal requires the file upload.
- We’ll need a completed vendor onboarding form plus a vendor code to tie to the PO (we can generate the vendor_id once form is in the portal).
- For SOW: does the draft include split-billing instructions? We sometimes accept a baseline PO + separate PO for expansions.

I can do a 20-min intake tomorrow at 10am ET to walk the portal fields. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Senior Procurement Manager — Orion Health Systems
procurement@orionhealth.com

[No attachments]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor recertification and PO synchronization — Redwood renewal & expansion

Thanks Sarah — attaching the SOC2 PDF and an updated SOW with a split-billing clause called out on page 2. We can accept a baseline PO now and a follow-up PO for the capacity uplift (preferred) or one consolidated PO if that’s simpler for you.

Attachment: SOC2_Redwood_2024.pdf (attached)
Attachment: SOW_Renewal_Orion_2025.docx (updated)

I’ll take the 10am ET intake tomorrow — please send the invite and portal link you’ll be using. I’ll also attach W9 + bank details in the follow-up once you confirm it’s safe to send.

Best,
Naomi

[Attachment: SOC2_Redwood_2024.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor recertification and PO synchronization — Redwood renewal & expansion

Naomi — quick internal note (not for Orion):
- Finance confirms we can accept a split PO (baseline renewal + separate expansion PO) and will attach a single invoice per PO.
- Legal okayed the split-billing clause in the SOW with a small redline (embedded).
- Ops: Jonas, can you prepare the W9 and bank routing doc and share to Naomi by Monday?

Thanks — Jordan
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@orionhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor recertification and PO synchronization — Redwood renewal & expansion

Naomi — following our intake: procurement can complete vendor setup and issue the baseline PO the week of 9/8 provided onboarding is submitted by EOD 9/2. Portal link and vendor requirements below.

Portal: https://orionhealth.procureportal.com/vendor-setup/12345
Required uploads: vendor onboarding form, SOC2 pdf, W9, bank details (plaintext or secure doc).
PO timing: baseline renewal PO will be issued once vendor_id assigned; expansion PO can be issued after capacity addendum sign-off.

Please upload the remaining docs to the portal by 9/02 to avoid a one-week delay. If you need us to accept docs via secure email, let me know.

Best,
Sarah

[No attachments]

- Upload Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf + SOC2_Redwood_2024.pdf to the portal (by 9/02 EOD)
- Upload W9_Redwood.pdf and Bank_Details.txt to secure portal (by 9/02 EOD)
- Jordan to confirm PO split parameters with Finance and notify once invoice cadence is set
- Marissa (CS) to schedule the capacity cutover notes for ops upon PO receipt

MAP (finalized):
- 9/02 EOD — vendor onboarding + W9 + bank details uploaded
- 9/08 — baseline renewal PO issued by Orion (vendor_id attached)
- Upon PO receipt — Redwood issues invoice; capacity addendum signed; expansion PO follows

Attachments to upload: W9_Redwood.pdf, Bank_Details.txt

I’ll post the portal confirmation and vendor_id when we have it. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Naomi
